(def ancestors
  "Returns the immediate and indirect parents of tag through a relationship
  established via derive. h must be a hierarchy obtained from make-hierarchy,
  if not supplied defaults to the global hierarchy"
  (fn
    ([tag] (ancestors @(get-global-hierarchy) tag))
    ([h tag] (not-empty (get (:ancestors h) tag)))))
rationale: Expand the complete pinned defn to def/fn, retaining its documentation (#30). Suss types have no supertypes, so the type-inheritance branches of Clojure's and ClojureScript's versions (bases, supers, isAssignableFrom) contribute nothing and are removed (#30).
